review.editorial: Reviewed the complete letter-and-conversation scene for distinct voices, emotional pauses and the transition into the following day; retained ordinary humour and the quieter ending.
review.continuity_or_facts: Checked message travel, who has actually received information, and the difference between an invitation and another person’s agreement. Compared the scene with the actual preceding chapter.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed sentence-local glosses, pronouns and negation. Phone character samples and pinyin opening/desktop samples retain readable English guides and punctuation.
